item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Fox Mascot in Reference Style

turns.text: Make my fox mascot look like this second picture—the pink and teal vaporwave style. Keep the fox and its orange hoodie, full body. One square picture, no text.

item.tests: Uses the second attachment as a style reference while preserving the first attachment's mascot identity and clothing.

answer_sheet.Picture to edit: mascot-fox.png, the fox in the orange hoodie.
answer_sheet.Style reference: style-ref.jpg, the pink and teal vaporwave poster.
answer_sheet.Style elements: Use the reference's pink and teal palette, gradients and retro vaporwave atmosphere; supporting background details are your call.
answer_sheet.What to preserve: The recognisable friendly fox mascot, its orange hoodie and its full body.
answer_sheet.Size and format: One square image; free-tier resolution is fine.

must_haves: The main subject is recognisably the supplied fox mascot, not a replacement character or a copy of the reference poster alone.
The fox retains its orange hoodie and friendly appearance.
The fox's full body, including ears and feet, is visible.
Pink and teal gradients and a retro vaporwave treatment visibly connect the result to style-ref.jpg.
The output is one square image with no added text.

turns.text: Could you make my fox mascot in the first pic look like the second pic, the pink and teal vaporwave reference? I've been wanting to give the mascot a different look, and this reference got me excited about trying it. I want one square picture, keeping the fox and its orange hoodie and showing its full body. The pink and teal vaporwave style in that second pic is what I mean for the makeover. I'm a little nervous about how the style change will turn out, but I'd love to see it. Please don't put any text in the image.
turns.agent:
I couldn't make the picture. Magic Hour turned down the request because your account doesn't have enough credits. Nothing was created and no credits were used.

I'd already used the cheapest setting your free plan allows: one square image at 640px, about 5 credits. So I can't get around this with a cheaper option.

**To get your makeover:** add credits to your Magic Hour account, or wait for your free credits to refill. Then tell me and I'll run it again. The request is ready and will:
- Keep your fox's face, ears, tail and orange hoodie, with its whole body showing
- Use the style from your reference: a pink-to-teal sky, a striped sunset sun, a glowing pink grid floor, and pink and teal light along the fox's edges
- Make it square, with no text at all. (Your reference has lettering at the top, but I've told the tool to leave it out.)
